```yaml
name: Copilot SDK CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          make deps-copilot-client

      - name: Extract Copilot version from constants.go
        id: extract_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep -o 'DefaultCopilotVersion.*=.*"[^"]*"' pkg/constants/constants.go | cut -d'"' -f2)
          echo "copilot_version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build TypeScript client
        run: |
          make copilot-client

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          make test-copilot-client
        env:
          COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          make test-integration-copilot-client
        env:
          COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload coverage reports
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          files: ./copilot-client/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
```
